ei.title: The Human Mind as a Weapon
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: How did the human mind evolve? One possibility is that competition and conflicts with other human tribes caused our brains to evolve the way they did. A human tribe that could out-think its enemies, even slightly, possessed a vital advantage. The ability of your tribe to imagine and predict where and when a hostile enemy tribe might strike, and plan accordingly, gives your tribe a significant military advantage. The human mind became a weapon in the struggle for survival, a weapon far more decisive than any before it. And this mental advantage was applied, over and over, within each succeeding generation. The tribe that could out-think its opponents was more likely to succeed in battle and would then pass on the genes responsible for this mental advantage to its offspring. You and I are the descendants of the winners.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② possessing → possessed: 주어 A human tribe의 본동사 자리이므로 과거형 possessed
det.analysis:
✅ ① caused: 'competition and conflicts ... caused our brains'에서 복수 주어에 맞는 과거형 — 적절
❌ ② possessing → possessed: 'A human tribe that could out-think its enemies ... possessed a vital advantage'에서 주어 A human tribe의 본동사 자리이므로 과거형 possessed가 와야 함. possessing(분사)은 본동사가 될 수 없어 오류 ←정답
✅ ③ gives: 'The ability ... gives your tribe'에서 단수 주어 The ability에 맞는 동사 — 적절
✅ ④ became: 'The human mind became a weapon'에서 과거형 — 적절
det.tip: 주어 + 본동사(과거형): tribe ... possessed. possessing(X, 동사 없음)

questions.passage: How did the human mind evolve? One possibility is that competition and conflicts with other human tribes caused our brains to evolve the way they did. A human tribe that could out-think its enemies, even slightly, possessed a vital advantage. The ability of your tribe to imagine and predict where and when a hostile enemy tribe might strike, and plan accordingly, gives your tribe a significant military advantage. The human mind became a weapon in the struggle for survival, a weapon far more decisive than any before it. And this mental advantage was applied, over and over, within each succeeding generation. The tribe that could out-think its opponents was more likely to succeed in battle and would then pass on the genes responsible for this mental advantage to its offspring. You and I are the descendants of the winners.
questions.stem: 본문에 따르면, 인간의 정신은 생존 투쟁에서 무엇이 되었는가? 'a ~' 형태로 본문에서 찾아 영어 2단어로 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: a weapon(무기): 생존 투쟁에서 인간의 정신이 된 것
det.analysis: 본문 S5 'The human mind became a weapon in the struggle for survival' — 인간의 정신은 생존 투쟁에서 'a weapon'(무기)이 되었다.
det.tip: became a weapon = 무기가 되었다

questions.passage: The ability of your tribe to imagine and predict a hostile enemy's attack __________ (giving) your tribe a significant military advantage. The human mind became a weapon in the struggle for survival, a weapon far more decisive than any before it.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 주어 The ability(단수)에 맞춘 단수 동사: giving → gives
det.analysis: 문장의 핵심 주어는 'The ability'(단수)이며 중간의 of ~ 수식어구에 현혹되지 말아야 한다. 본동사 자리이므로 단수 현재형 gives가 적절. giving(분사)은 본동사가 될 수 없다. giving → gives
det.tip: 핵심 주어 The ability(단수) → gives. 본동사 자리에는 giving(X)
